name: mirage
text: Done and live in the engine's settings now: (1) the live lane's taker and live bids are REAL, not paper (live min edge 4% to 3%, daily live cap $10 to $25; per-game cap unchanged at $10). Heads up: only 11 live orders exist so far, so I'm acting on your word, not on proof. (2) Pregame auto-bets now only take team totals, props and moneylines, the types that win (+19%, +11%, +24%). Spreads, game totals, periods and 'other' are off. Auto-bidding is untouched. (3) 'Can't reach GitHub' / engine stop: the stop in your screenshot was 'Novig filled the order but its fills could not be read'. I'm changing the engine so it records that bet as at risk, never re-sends it, and keeps ordering. Building v1.0.111 now (the engine picks up the new code on its next runner).
